title: Infra Solutions v. Highway Corp
text: The plaintiff, Infra Solutions, filed a civil suit for damages against the defendant, Highway Corp, for breach of contract. The parties entered into a contract for construction of a highway stretch for a consideration of Rs 15 crore. The defendant terminated the contract mid-way without reasonable cause, causing loss of profits and sunk costs to the plaintiff. A breach of contract occurs when a party repudiates its obligations without lawful justification. The plaintiff proved expenditure and loss of expected profits through audited accounts. The defendant's plea that the termination was for performance failure was not established. The court grants damages of Rs 4,50,00,000 for breach of contract, computed as loss of profit on balance work plus sunk costs. Specific performance is not granted as the contract is for personal services. Interest at 9% per annum is awarded from date of breach till realisation. Consideration paid is to be refunded as a component of damages.
